entity: AMA-Motorcycle Industry Council Combined Committee on Land Use
summary: The AMA-MIC Combined Committee on Land Use is referenced within the AMA's letter as sharing the view that a comprehensive, scientifically-based land classification system is needed to ensure fair and equitable ORV use on public lands. The committee is actively working to hire a professional ecologist to develop clear guidelines for land use, acknowledging that some public land may be lost to ORV use but expressing willingness to cooperate. Their position is conditional — supporting ORV access where scientifically justified, while accepting reasonable restrictions based on evidence.

statement.text: This statement by the Task Force reflects very accurately the feeling of the American Motorcycle Association, and of the AMA-Motorcycle Industry Council Combined Committee on Land Use. This committee, composed of delegates from the AMA and the MIC, presently is reviewing resumes by professional ecologists. The group has resolved to hire one of these gentlemen for the purpose of establishing guidelines in a very comprehensive and clear textbook fashion. Through such a set of guidelines we hope to establish fair and equitable use of the land, knowing full well that some public land will be lost to the use of off-road recreational vehicles, yet with the feeling that our effort to cooperate will be returned by those with other interests.
